question: When include_tags and include_categories are false, are the dump's tools still imported (no option covers them), or are they dropped along with the tags and categories as part of "no organizers"?
readings: Tools are always kept: the import page offers options for tags and categories only, so nothing switches tools off.
Tools are organizers too and are dropped whenever the organizer options are off.
upstream: Tools are always kept; only tags and categories follow include_tags and include_categories.
rationale: The request ties the two options to tags and categories and lists tools among the content a paste keeps, but does not say what the options mean for tools, which are organizers in the same sense; both readings are coherent with the import page. The target test pastes with both options false and expects the tools to be present.
